label.summary: Multiple claims address economic growth as a central goal, with some linking it to infrastructure investment and job creation. Both Democratic and Republican claims emphasize economic growth as a means to improve living standards and reduce poverty, though they differ on the methods to achieve it. Democrats specifically highlight infrastructure and clean energy as drivers of growth, while Republicans focus on deregulation and economic freedom.
label.title: Economic Growth and Infrastructure Investment

claims.claim_text: Investments in infrastructure and manufacturing are helping millions of people thrive.

The United States economy can be restructured in an ecologically sustainable direction and one that provides good jobs at good wages only if the federal government invests significantly in infrastructure development, alternative energy, and mass-transit technologies.
Cutting tax rates, simplifying the tax code, deregulating industries, and opening world markets to American enterprise resulted in tremendous growth in the 1980s.

President Obama and Democrats around the country are fighting back from the deepest economic crisis since the Great Depression by laying the foundations for an economy that out-educates, out-builds, and out-innovates the rest of the world.

By balancing environmental goals with economic growth and job creation, the American economy has made possible the investment needed to safeguard natural resources, protect endangered species, and create healthier living conditions.
President Obama and Democrats around the country are fighting back from the deepest economic crisis since the Great Depression by growing the middle class.
When women and girls are healthy, educated, and able to participate economically, their families and communities prosper, poverty decreases, and economies grow.
When women and girls are healthy, educated, and able to participate economically, their families and communities prosper, poverty decreases, and economies grow.
Economic growth allows people to lift their lives out of poverty.
Countries like Germany, Spain and Brazil have reaped the benefits of economic growth from clean energy.
Growing economic ties between the United States, Mexico, and Canada can address environmental and social issues of common concern.
Economic freedom expands the prosperity pie.
